ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the figure is a regulated power supply circuit composed of CW7812 and an operational amplifier. The node labeled C is located at the connection of R1, R3, and R2, and from this node there is a wire connected to the inverting input terminal (−) of the operational amplifier. The non-inverting input terminal (+) of the operational amplifier is connected to the bottom common line, which has a ground symbol. R2 is connected from point C to the node where the operational amplifier output terminal is located, forming a feedback path from the output terminal back to the inverting input terminal. Reasoning: Since the operational amplifier forms negative feedback through R2, under the ideal operational amplifier approximation the virtual short principle can be used, namely the potential of the inverting input terminal is equal to the potential of the non-inverting input terminal. Because the non-inverting input terminal is grounded, its potential is 0 V, therefore the potential of point C is also 0 V.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, which is a regulated power supply using the integrated regulator CW7812, the potential at point C is ________ V.

method.method_draft: First read the circuit topology from the image: locate point C and verify that it is connected to the op-amp inverting input, while the op-amp non-inverting input is connected to the ground symbol. Also note the feedback path from the op-amp output back to C through R2, so the op-amp is in a negative-feedback condition. Then apply the virtual-short rule for an ideal op-amp: V− = V+. Because V+ is grounded, V_C = 0 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中右侧是由 CW7812 和运算放大器构成的稳压电源电路。标号 C 的节点位于 R1、R3、R2 的连接处，并且从该节点有连线接到运算放大器的反相输入端（−）。运算放大器的同相输入端（+）接到底部公共线，该公共线带有接地符号。R2 从点 C 接到运算放大器输出端所在节点，形成从输出端回到反相输入端的反馈通路。推理：由于运算放大器通过 R2 构成负反馈，在理想运算放大器近似下可使用虚短原则，即反相输入端电位等于同相输入端电位。因为同相输入端接地，所以其电位为 0 V，因此点 C 的电位也为 0 V。

planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the figure: point C is the junction of resistors R1, R2, and R3 and is wired to the inverting input of the operational amplifier. The non-inverting input of the same amplifier is connected to the ground rail, and the amplifier output near point B is fed back to point C through R2, indicating negative feedback.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to identify that the requested quantity is the potential at point C in the shown CW7812 regulated power-supply circuit, expressed in volts.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For an ideal operational amplifier operating with negative feedback, the inverting and non-inverting input potentials are approximately equal. Since the non-inverting input is grounded, its potential is 0 V, so the inverting input node C is a virtual ground at 0 V.
